Data sets

Metrics Data for Quantifying Multidimensional Impacts of Landscape Change in California’s Sacramento–San Joaquin Delta (version 2). DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.7504873 (also included in the DeltaMultipleBenefits package)

Distribution models for riparian landbirds and waterbirds in the Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.7531945

Distribution model objects for tidal wetland birds in the Sacramento-San Joaquin Delta. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20722832

Supplemental Spatial Data for Quantifying Multidimensional Impacts of Landscape Change in California’s Sacramento–San Joaquin Delta. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.7672193

Data available through CDFW’s BIOS system

Phase 1 baseline and projected future land use and land cover under perennial crop expansion and restoration scenarios [ds3038-ds3045]

Predicted habitat distributions for 9 breeding riparian landbird species and 6 waterbird groups during the fall and winter under Phase 1 baseline conditions [ds3046-ds3065]

Priority Bird Conservation Areas for riparian landbirds and waterbirds under Phase 1 baseline conditions [ds3066-ds3069]

Phase 2 baseline land cover and tidal wetland restoration scenarios [ds3362-ds3368]

Predicted habitat distributions for secretive marsh birds and tidal wetlands songbirds under Phase 2 baseline conditions [ds3369-ds3375]

Priority Marsh Bird Conservation Areas under Phase 2 baseline conditions [ds3376-ds3378]
